title: C# Master Project
description: Congratulations on completing the C# track! It is time to apply everything you've learned. In this final project, you will build the logic for small applications.

challenges.title: Calculator Method
challenges.exercise: Create a method 'static double Calc(double a, double b, char op)'. Handle '+', '-', '*', '/'. Return 0 if op is invalid. Call Console.WriteLine(Calc(10, 2, '/')).

challenges.title: To-Do Manager (Add)
challenges.exercise: Create class 'ToDo' with 'List<string> tasks = new List<string>();'. Create method 'public void Add(string t)'. Add 'Study', 'Sleep'. Print tasks[0].

challenges.title: To-Do Manager (Complete)
challenges.exercise: Add a 'public void Complete(string t)' method to ToDo that calls tasks.Remove(t). Assume tasks has 'Study'. Complete('Study'). Print tasks.Count.

challenges.title: Data Analyzer
challenges.exercise: Given int[] scores = {80, 95, 70, 100}. Use LINQ (.Max(), .Min(), .Average()) to print max, min, and average on separate lines.

challenges.title: Master Developer
challenges.exercise: You have mastered C# basics! Write a static method 'Greet(string name)' that returns $"Welcome, {name}!". Print Greet("Aris").
